messages.text: Searched the catalog · Harlo H15 Dual Bitcoin Dogecoin miner

Same box — the H15 mines both at once, so there's only one unit on your desk: 15 TH/s Bitcoin plus 1.08 GH/s scrypt for Doge/LTC, about 450W total.

Honest bit: it's ~50 dB and 450W of heat. Fine on a shelf or in a corner of an office; at arm's length on a desk all day it's a constant fan hum.

Is the room you're thinking of one you sit in all day?
